purpose: Rules for the auditors of the screening stages (stage S5 in the protocol). Fill every {{...}}; the examples show one way, not the required one.
target: {{TARGET, e.g. false exclusion: a record excluded by the screening program that should have been kept}}

full_text.used_for: {{e.g. audit of full-text exclusions; review of abstract-audit candidates that pass the frozen full-text screen}}
full_text.reviewers: {{e.g. two primary auditors from different vendors; a third only on disagreement; majority by code}}
response: criterion_results: one entry per criterion with supported (true/false) and page-level evidence
full_text.human_adjudication: {{WHEN_AND_WITH_WHAT_EVIDENCE, e.g. only when the reviewer majority says INCLUDE; confirmed only with a page citation}}

inputs: complete abstract, or null when none exists
abstract.retain_rule: {{e.g. RETAIN unless the title and abstract clearly establish an exclusion; a RETAIN is a candidate, not an error}}
abstract.candidate_route: {{e.g. retrieve the full text and run the frozen full-text screen; a record the screen includes is reviewed in full_text mode}}

reason_codes.POTENTIALLY_ELIGIBLE: required for RETAIN_FOR_FULL_TEXT and for INCLUDE
reason_codes.{{CODE_FOR_C1}}: the material clearly establishes that criterion C1 fails
reason_codes.{{CODE_FOR_C2}}: the material clearly establishes that criterion C2 fails

technical_failure: {{RETRY_POLICY, e.g. refusals, malformed output, missing fields and identity mismatches are retried with the same request and never become an EXCLUDE, a vote or a clean round}}

evidence_contract.locator: {{e.g. page or section for full text; 'title' or 'abstract' for the abstract mode}}
evidence_contract.quote: {{a short quote from the supplied text}}
